says: In today's CI, SC17 compares select's SCOPE through compact, which passes a value that is not an expression unchanged, so SCOPE: inputs.scope (the plain text, with no ${{ }}) passes the lint and the step would get the literal text.
proof: A scratch node script ran lintScheduled on the real scheduled.yaml with select's set step env SCOPE set to each value. It printed `SCOPE= inputs.scope []` (no error) and `SCOPE= ${{ github.event.inputs.scope }} ["scheduled.yaml: SC17: ..."]`. shared.ts compact only strips ${{ }} when both ends are present.
cost: It fails closed: askOf throws on the text inputs.scope, so every branch proof is red at select until someone reads the log. The lint should have named it.
